answer: Because the horizon fee is applied at the vertex exit, the terrace audit totals the burn and the ledger makes public exactly what left. An operator rotating funds across many keys therefore bleeds value on each hop, which is a cost an agent that leaves its stake in place never pays. Withdrawing stake costs a 12% fee that is burned rather than redistributed, so moving capital between aliases destroys a slice of it every time. That is 30 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
